product.name: AI Research Agents
product.description: AI agents that scrape and extract custom data from the web, providing tailored research results not available through traditional methods.

product.name: Verified Contacts Solutions
product.description: A service providing real-time verified contact information with a 0% email bounce guarantee, ensuring accurate phone numbers and emails for outreach.

product.name: AI-Powered Search
product.description: An AI-driven search platform with precise filters to find companies, jobs, and people from extensive databases updated daily.

product.name: Industry-Optimized Waterfall Validation
product.description: A multi-provider contact data validation process that ensures high accuracy and low bounce rates for exported contact information.

product.name: Integration and Export Tools
product.description: Tools that enable unlimited exports and synchronization of contact and talent data with over 30 ATS, 20 CRM, and 10 outreach platforms.
